name: Settlement
description: A village by the road, drawn from shapes: cottages of several builds and log cabins with lit windows and smoking chimneys, a well, a market stall, picket fences, hay bales, a cart and a woodpile. Use as "@settlement#<name>".

well.description: A stone well with a little roof, a windlass and a bucket.

market_stall.description: A market stall: a counter heaped with fruit and bread under a striped awning.

picket_fence.description: A white picket fence, two metres to a section: space its layer every 1.9 m for an unbroken fence.

haybale.description: A bale of hay, tied with twine.

cart.description: A wooden hand cart loaded with hay.

woodpile.description: Split logs stacked for the winter, their cut ends showing.

cottage_timber.description: A timber-framed cottage: plastered panels between oak posts, braced in the bays without windows; a tiled roof, a brick chimney on the ridge, lit windows.

cottage_stone.description: A stone cottage: rubble walls with dressed corner stones, white-framed windows under stone lintels, a green door and a slate roof with a stone chimney at the back.

cottage_thatch.description: A whitewashed cottage under a deep thatched roof: tarred base, small deep windows with blue shutters, a blue door and a white chimney in the middle of the ridge.

cottage_brick.description: A tall brick house of two storeys: sash windows under brick lintels, a black door with a lit fanlight, a slate roof with a chimney at each end of the ridge.

cottage_board.description: A weatherboarded cottage painted sage green: white corner boards and window frames, dark green shutters, a red door and a shingle roof with a brick chimney.

log_cabin_small.description: A small log cabin: round logs saddle-notched at the corners, their sawn tails stacking out both ways by turns; one lit window and a plank door, a shingle roof and a stone chimney built up outside its side wall.

log_cabin_porch.description: A log cabin with a front porch: a plank deck under a lean-to roof on posts, a railing either side of the steps, two lit windows and a stone chimney on the ridge.

log_cabin_sod.description: A log cabin with a turf roof in the northern way: dark logs, white window frames, grass and wild flowers growing over a low roof edged with birch bark.

cottage.description: A cottage of the village, each one built differently: timber-framed, stone, whitewashed under thatch, two storeys of brick or weatherboarded; lit windows and a smoking chimney, lighting the ground before it.

log_cabin.description: A log cabin, each one different: a small one with a stone chimney up its side, one with a front porch, one with a turf roof.
